def.description: Galleon ~14.2 m long (hull 11.5 + bowsprit at 18 deg), beam 4.3. 60 lofted cross-sections with strong sheer (deck 2.2 mid, 3.0 at ends), raised keel at bow/stern; gold wale and rail 0.14 m; 6 red-framed gun ports per side; two-tier stern castle ~2.3 m above deck with 0.65 m aft overhang, windows and lantern; 1.3 m forecastle with rounded front; three masts (12.6/11.2/9.6 m) with yards, wide billowing cream sails 2-3 tiers, shrouds, stays, red pennants.
